== Trivia ==
*With a {{Item|Bat Pet|rarity=l}}, this sword can deal up to {{red|3 Damage}} to Spooky Mobs per hit.
*It is still recommended to have [[enchantments]] on this sword, as a [[Spooky Mobs|Spooky Mob]] can spawn from [[Trick or Treat Chest]]s in the middle of normal mobs, where [[enchantments]] can help clear those mobs.
